dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.refactor.quickassist.changetypetovar>
<!description: Use specific relevance constant for 'change type to var' quick assist, replacing the generic 'CHANGE_VARIABLE'.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.correction.IProposalRelevance.CHANGE_VARIABLE :: inMethod("org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.correction.QuickAssistProcessor.convertExplicitTypeToVar")
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.correction.IProposalRelevance.CHANGE_TYPE_TO_VAR
;;
summary: Replaces a generic proposal relevance constant with a more specific one for 'change type to var' quick assist within a particular method.
